name: whitecadae
description: White Cadae — Escape Game Orange, musique et paroles (Cloudflare Workers + D1)

scripts.deploy:ci: pnpm run build:ci && node scripts/prepare-deployment.mjs && wrangler deploy --keep-vars --experimental-provision=false && pnpm run verify:deployment
scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 execute whitecadae-db --local --file=./schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute whitecadae-db --local --file=./seed.sql
